description:
Manage your Youtrust signature requests directly from ChatGPT, without opening a new tab. Check whether someone has signed, get a full overview of everything still pending, and send documents from your templates, all in plain language. Ask questions, confirm statuses, and handle e-signatures while staying in the flow of what you were already doing.

Youtrust enables businesses to easily and securely manage legally-binding electronic signatures, identity verification, and electronic seals, in full compliance with European standards such as eIDAS.
